exposure: infant loss after prior live birth
cohort: The study included 9,439,520 women in the U.S., comprising 51% Non-Hispanic White, 15% Non-Hispanic Black, 25% Hispanic, 6% Asian, and 3% Other, with a mean age of 29.8 years.
finding: Infant loss after prior live birth was significantly associated with higher odds of HDP overall, with Non-Hispanic Black women having higher odds and Hispanic and Asian women having lower odds compared to Non-Hispanic White women.
